stem.text: The statements describe the phagocytosis of a bacterium by a macrophage.

items: Digestive enzymes break down the bacterium.
Macrophage displays the bacterial antigens on its cell surface membrane.
Macrophage engulfs the bacterium and encloses it in a vacuole.
Receptors on the cell surface membrane of macrophage bind to the bacterium.
